observations: Photo 0 shows a metal gearbox/speed reducer unit with a circular end housing and multiple cooling fins on the body.
There is a shaft opening/port on the front circular face, with visible bolts/screws around the housing.

No clear indication of input/output type (motor coupling, flange size, shaft diameter) is readable from this single angle.

claims.claim: This his a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gearbox/speed-reducer style metal unit with fins and a front output housing consistent with a motor speed reducer.

risks.risk: Exact type and specifications (gear ratio, input/output shaft size, mounting/flange pattern) are not readable, so the unit may not match the buyer’s motor/application.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/rating plate (gear ratio, model, input RPM, output RPM, mounting type) and a close-up measurement of input/output shaft diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic speed reducer with unknown ratio/spec (worst-case: may not fit or may be unsuitable).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be worn, noisy, leaking, or damaged internally).
risks.proof: Video of it running under load (or at least spin test) showing smooth rotation and no abnormal noise, plus a photo of any oil level/leak points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: needs servicing/repair).

risks.risk: Compatibility of mounting and coupling is uncertain (may require specific motor coupling or adapter).
risks.proof: Photos showing the mounting face(s) and bolt-hole pattern, plus the motor-side coupling/shaft interface (with measurements).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring possible adapter/fitment work (worst-case: extra parts needed).

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect accessories (oil seals, breather, mounting bolts, coupling) could affect operation.
risks.proof: Inventory photo of included parts and close-ups of seals/breather/ports; confirm what is included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the nameplate/rating plate (model, gear ratio, input/output RPM, voltage if any, serial number).
Send close-up photos of the input and output shaft ends (with shaft diameter measurements).
Send photos of the mounting face(s) and bolt-hole pattern (and any flange/coupling interface).
Send a short video showing the reducer running/spinning smoothly (and confirm whether it is oil-filled and whether there are leaks).
Confirm the exact gear ratio and whether it is single-stage or multi-stage (if shown on the plate).
response.reason: The photo confirms it is a speed-reducer/gearbox type, but the key pricing drivers (model/gear ratio/specs and working condition) are not readable or verifiable from the single image. Without the nameplate and a working/spin test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
